expected.report:
SPECIMEN:
(A) Ascending colon polyp
(B) caecal polyp 12 mm
(C) Rectum polyp

MICROSCOPIC EXAMINATION:
(A)  Sections show a serrated polyp with architectural features in keeping with a sessile serrated lesion / adenoma. No cytological dysplasia is identified. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy. The lesion is completely excised in the planes examined.

(B)  Sections show a sessile serrated lesion / adenoma with superimposed high grade dysplasia. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

(C)  Sections show a serrated polyp with ectopic crypt formation and high grade dysplasia, in keeping with a traditional serrated adenoma. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy. The base is not clearly represented.

DIAGNOSIS:
(A) ASCENDING COLON, Ascending colon polyp, polypectomy - SESSILE SERRATED LESION / ADENOMA.
(B) CAECUM, caecal polyp 12 mm, polypectomy - SESSILE SERRATED LESION / ADENOMA WITH HIGH GRADE DYSPLASIA.
(C) RECTUM, Rectum polyp, polypectomy - TRADITIONAL SERRATED ADENOMA WITH HIGH GRADE DYSPLASIA.
